gates.description: Every changed route or product behavior has linked, reviewable evidence.
No unresolved safety, access, gauge, privacy, or data-integrity blocker remains.
An independent verifier confirms the change and its evidence package.
Focused tests, typechecks, route audits, and production build/smoke checks pass.
A bounded rollback or revert path is identified before merge.

dispositionDefinitions.covered: Eligible route-capable gauge with a direct same-reach scored route that passes evidence, access, safety, threshold, camping/logistics, coordinate, geometry, image, and audit gates.
dispositionDefinitions.blocked: Potentially useful gauge or reach with a precise evidence, access, provider, threshold, safety, coordinate, camping/logistics, or geometry blocker and a documented retry condition; reviewed but not route-covered.
dispositionDefinitions.screened_out: Durably reviewed gauge that is not paddle-relevant under the supported product model, such as a drainage, tidal/bay, lake/spillway, canal, or urban gauge without a plausible public point-to-point reach.
dispositionDefinitions.stale_or_unsupported: Gauge identity, telemetry, or provider support is not reliable enough for a current decision; reopen only after fresh provider evidence.
dispositionDefinitions.researching_or_unreviewed: Temporary states that prevent state completion.

routeReadinessDefinitions.published: A scored route directly uses the gauge and passes publication gates.
routeReadinessDefinitions.candidate: Existing route-family or direct-corridor evidence makes this a plausible route-development candidate.
routeReadinessDefinitions.research_needed: The gauge is route-capable, but the existing review does not yet establish a distinct route candidate.
routeReadinessDefinitions.existing_route_gap: The reach is already represented or provider-equivalent; the remaining work is gauge integration or coverage accounting, not a duplicate route.
routeReadinessDefinitions.deferred: The review names an explicit retry condition or requires materially new external evidence.
routeReadinessDefinitions.screened_out: The reviewed gauge is not paddle-relevant under the supported product model.
routeReadinessDefinitions.unsupported: Gauge identity or telemetry is stale or unsupported.
routeReadinessDefinitions.unreviewed: No durable gauge review has been completed.

coverageComplete: every eligible gauge has a final disposition
every route-capable gauge is covered or has an accepted blocker
no gauge remains unreviewed or researching
saturated: existing route packages pass quality audits
bounded fresh discovery sweep across distinct gauge and river families finds no additional strong scored route

requiredBeforeDone: every eligible gauge has a durable disposition
every route-capable gauge is covered or has an accepted blocker
bounded fresh discovery sweep across distinct candidate families
no candidate clears the scored-route evidence, safety, gauge, access, camping, geometry, coordinate, and image gates
saturationPolicy.discoveryBudget: bounded by the active state task; stop after the documented candidate budget or when a strong scored route is found
saturationPolicy.reopenCondition: new eligible gauge, resumed telemetry, cleared blocker, user demand, provider expansion, retired direct coverage, or fresh manager-grade access, threshold, safety, or route-shape evidence

routeOpportunityPolicy.geographicExpansion: when the current registered frontier is complete, advance only through an explicit next-state task; do not recycle durable blockers
